shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin dipped below $75,000, driven by escalating US-Iran geopolitical tensions and significant liquidations.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $1.26 billion in net outflows over six days, heightening bearish market sentiment.
Crypto markets face caution due to a hawkish Federal Reserve stance, rising inflation expectations, and record low consumer sentiment.
The EU is seeking input on its MiCA crypto framework, while US regulatory clarity initiatives like the CLARITY Act remain key market drivers.
